report.explanation: Inventory shows invalid configuration (cfg-117), 21 configuration rejections, and configuration_value_rejected ERROR logs with 503s alongside a 0.15 error rate and errored checkout spans; gateway calls to inventory error. Gateway itself is healthy (0.001 error rate, 200s). This supports bad-configuration as the bounded root-cause candidate.
